source: Provider RT(ms), from deduplicated and reconciled evaluation-phase logs.
metric: Provider-reported complete API response time; not simulation time or token generation time.
inclusion: HTTP 200, provider result success, positive output tokens, finite positive RT. Retried requests satisfying these conditions are included once per RequestID.
exclusion: Failed API requests and successful-status responses without output tokens; no latency outlier removal.

histogram.normalization: Each bin count divided by all included requests in its own mode; tail not renormalized.
